name: Stratagus
subtitle: Warcraft II for iPhone & iPad
localizedDescription: Warcraft II (Wargus) on iPhone and iPad, running the Stratagus engine natively. Single-player and local-network multiplayer, with touch and gesture controls, an on-screen keyboard, and saves visible in the Files app. Ships with no game content; you supply your own Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition files.
